entities.summary: Jorge Beauchef was a French military officer who participated in the Napoleonic Wars. He is best known in Latin America for his participation in the Chilean War of Independence, where he won many battles. This first battle, one of the most famous, ensured Chile's independence, putting an end to the continuous Spanish domination since 1536.
